V. 34.
What have we to do with thee—Thy preſent Buſineſs is with Men, not with Devils. I know thee who thou art—But ſurely he did not know a little before, that He was GOD over all, bleſſed for ever: Or he would not have dared to tell Him, All this power is delivered to me, and I give it to whomſoever I will. The Holy one of God—Either this Confeſſion was ext••ted from him by Terror (for the Devils believe and tremble) or he made it with a Deſign 〈◊〉 render the Character of Chriſt ſuſpected. Poſſibly it was from hence the Phariſees took Occaſion to ſay, He caſteth out devils by the prime of the dev•ls.
